 COMMON ORDER Since the issue involved in both these writ petitions are common they are taken up together, heard and disposed of through this common order.
2. These petitions have been filed to quash the proceedings in C.C.Nos.97 & 98 of 2020 on the file of XVII Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Saidapet, Chennai.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. The first respondent has enquired the criminal complaint against the petitioners for offences u/s.52 and 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 [for brevity 'the FSS Act'].
4.

The main ground that was urged by learned counsel for https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.Nos.21076 & 21080 of 2022 petitioners is that the sample was taken on 26.10.2018 and the food analysis report, which is supposed to be given within 14 days was sent only after a period of nine months and therefore, there is a violation of Section 42(2) of the FSS Act.

Learned counsel further submitted that the only reason that has been given for the delay was that there was some administrative delay and therefore, the report was given beyond the time stipulated u/s.42(2) of the FSS Act.

5. Heard Mr.G.Balasubramanian, learned counsel for petitioners and Mr.A.Damodaran, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for first respondent.
6. The issue that is invovled in the present case is covered by the earlier orders passed by this Court in (i) Amma Naana Departmental Stores and others v. State of Tamil Nadu [2020 SCC OnLine Mad 9099] (ii) G.Irudhayanathan v. B.Ramakrishnan [2020 SCC OnLine Mad 12748] and (iii)
R.Paduvairajan and another v. Food Safety Officer [2021 SCC OnLine Mad 9289].

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is clear from the above three orders that where there is violation Section 42(2) of the FSS Act, the N.ANAND VENKATESH, J.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.Nos.21076 & 21080 of 2022 gm complaint itself will be barred and the above orders will squarely apply to the facts of the present cases.

In the light of the above discussion, these Criminal Original Petitions are allowed and the proceedings in C.C.Nos.97 & 98 of 2020 on the file of XVII Metropolitan Magistrate Court, Saidapet,
